items_flat.title_en: Altman and Amodei brief UN Security Council on AI risk
items_flat.title_zh: Altman與Amodei向聯合國安理會簡報AI風險
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei addressed a UN Security Council session on AI during UNGA week. Altman, in person, called for international standards on measuring capabilities, assessing risks, checking safeguards and keeping human oversight. Amodei, by video, called AI the most important global security issue if mismanaged and urged narrow agreements, including a ban on using AI for biological weapons, plus verification and incident notification.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI執行長Sam Altman與Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei在聯大周期間向聯合國安理會說明AI。Altman現場呼籲就能力測量、風險評估、防護是否足夠與人類監督建立國際標準。Amodei視訊表示若管理失當，AI可能危及全人類，並主張先談窄範圍協議（含禁止用AI製造生物武器）、查核與重大資安事件通報。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the highest-profile political forum the two labs have shared this week, but it is testimony, not a treaty. Whether the Council or member states turn the asks into measurable standards remains unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是本週兩家實驗室同台層級最高的政治場合，但仍是作證而非條約。安理會或會員國會否把訴求變成可量測標準，目前無法證實。
items_flat.quote: I believe that this is the most important global security issue facing the world today. If managed poorly, I even believe that A.I. could be a risk to humanity as a whole.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我認為這是當今世界最重要的全球安全議題。若管理失當，我甚至相信AI可能對全人類構成風險。

items_flat.title_en: Meta Connect: Muse comes to glasses with Realtime Avatar
items_flat.title_zh: Meta Connect：Muse上眼鏡並推出Realtime Avatar
items_flat.summary_en: At Connect 2026 Meta said Muse will come to its AI glasses in the coming months, and unveiled Muse Realtime Avatar to turn Muse Realtime Voice into a live talking face. It also launched camera-free Ray-Ban Meta Audio glasses, more Ray-Ban/Oakley/Meta styles, and Meta VR Glasses (about 100 g, on sale spring 2027 at $1,299.99).
items_flat.summary_zh: Connect 2026上，Meta宣布未來數月把Muse接到AI眼鏡，並發表Muse Realtime Avatar，把Realtime Voice變成可即時對話的臉。同時推出無相機的Ray-Ban Meta Audio、更多眼鏡款式，以及約100克的Meta VR Glasses（預計2027年春上市，售價1,299.99美元）。
items_flat.analysis_en: The AI story is distribution of Muse onto always-on wearables, not a new flagship text model. Whether Realtime Avatar stays consistent in long calls, and when glasses Muse ships outside the US, is still a product question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 重點是把Muse鋪到全天候穿戴裝置，不是新的旗艦文字模型。Realtime Avatar長通話是否穩、眼鏡版Muse何時出美國，仍是產品問題。
items_flat.quote: @finkd just unveiled Muse Realtime Avatar, our real-time embodiment technology that turns Muse Realtime Voice into expressive, interactive avatars.
items_flat.quote_zh: Zuckerberg剛發表Muse Realtime Avatar，這項即時具身技術把Muse Realtime Voice變成有表情、可互動的虛擬形象。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI extends Daybreak cyber access to Ukraine
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI將Daybreak網路防禦計畫開放給烏克蘭
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it will give Ukraine’s government access to its Daybreak program to help defend civilian infrastructure, working with the Ministry of Digital Transformation. Daybreak is for authorized security work such as reviewing legacy software, investigating suspicious activity, validating vulnerabilities and testing fixes. The announcement was made on the sidelines of UNGA.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布與烏克蘭數位轉型部合作，讓烏克蘭政府使用Daybreak，協助防護民用基礎設施。Daybreak用於授權資安工作，例如檢視舊系統、調查異常、驗證漏洞與測試修補。宣布場合在聯大周邊。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a policy deployment of frontier cyber tools, not a new model launch. Independent reporting says access includes GPT-5.6 Sol and is framed as free support; the official post does not name a model or price.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是前沿資安工具的政策部署，不是新模型。獨立報導稱包含GPT-5.6 Sol並以免費支援包裝；官方文未點名型號或價格。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI today announced it will offer the Government of Ukraine access to its Daybreak program to support the cyber defense of civilian infrastructure.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI今日宣布將向烏克蘭政府提供Daybreak計畫，以支援民用基礎設施的網路防禦。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS for custom voice design and line-by-line direction, and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS for high-volume, lower-cost speech. Both support 100+ languages and ship in AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Notebook and Vids. Google says Flash TTS leads Hume’s Voice Design Benchmark at 71.4.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google推出Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS（自訂音色與逐句導演）以及面向大量、較低成本的Flash-Lite TTS。兩者支援100多種語言，可在AI Studio、Gemini API、Enterprise、Notebook與Vids使用。Google稱Flash TTS在Hume Voice Design基準拿下71.4、整體第一。
items_flat.analysis_en: This extends Gemini Audio after Live models, competing on controllable production speech rather than a new text flagship. Voice replication is geo-restricted, so availability and rights terms still need checking per market.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是接在Live之後擴充Gemini Audio，比的是可導演的製作語音，不是新文字旗艦。聲音複製有地區限制，各地可用性與權利條款仍須核對。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS are our most expressive audio generation models yet.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS與Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS是我們迄今最具表現力的語音生成模型。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic says Claude discovered a CRISPR-like phage enzyme system
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic稱Claude發現類CRISPR噬菌體酶系統
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic introduced a new in-house life-sciences lab and said Claude agents, given a high-level prompt, found array-associated reverse transcriptases (ART) in jumbo-phage DNA—an uncharacterized RT plus a partner gene and CRISPR-like repeats. The company says about 950 agents used 210 million tokens over 21 hours before a hit; humans then validated the find in the lab. Anthropic says ART’s biological job is still unknown.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic公布自建生命科學實驗室，並稱在高層提示下，Claude代理在巨型噬菌體DNA中找到陣列相關反轉錄酶（ART）：未充分描述的RT、伴隨基因與類CRISPR重複序列。公司說約950個代理、2.1億token、21小時後命中，再由人類在實驗室驗證。Anthropic表示ART的生物學功能仍未知。
items_flat.analysis_en: The claim is agent-led genome mining plus human validation, not a proven gene-editing tool. Independent labs still need to reproduce the system and show function.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是代理主導的基因組探勘加上人類驗證，不是已證實的基因編輯工具。仍需獨立實驗室重現系統並證明功能。
items_flat.quote: [The DNA next to the RT] is spectacular: I can see by eye a tandem repeat array … that's a CRISPR-like … repeat array?!
items_flat.quote_zh: （RT旁的DNA）太壯觀了：我用肉眼就能看到串聯重複陣列……那是類CRISPR的重複陣列？！

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases open MentalHealthBench with 80+ clinicians
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI與80多名臨床專家發布開放MentalHealthBench
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published MentalHealthBench, an open evaluation of 1,215 synthetic mental-health conversations co-created with more than 80 licensed experts in 22 countries. It scores safety, context-seeking, user agency and guidance across non-acute to emergency scenarios covering adults, teens, caregivers and clinicians.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布開放評測MentalHealthBench：1,215則合成心理健康對話，與22國80多名持證專家共同製作。評分涵蓋安全、追問脈絡、使用者自主與指引，場景從非急性到緊急，對象含成人、青少年、照顧者與臨床人員。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a measurement and safety product, not a therapy feature. Scores are OpenAI-run with an automated grader; other labs can now rerun the open set, which is the main check on whether the ranking holds.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是量測與安全產品，不是治療功能。分數由OpenAI用自動評分器跑出；其他實驗室可重跑開放題庫，這才是排名能否站得住的檢驗。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing MentalHealthBench, a new open benchmark for measuring how AI systems respond in realistic mental health conversations.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出MentalHealthBench，這是衡量AI系統在真實心理健康對話中如何回應的新開放基準。

items_flat.title_en: Amazon opens seller tools to Claude and Quick agents
items_flat.title_zh: Amazon將賣家工具接到Claude與Quick代理
items_flat.summary_en: Amazon said Seller Assistant now keeps persistent memory and can run always-on workflows for restocking, pricing and alerts, still on Bedrock with Claude. A Selling Partner plugin launches in Amazon Quick and in beta with Anthropic’s Claude, with a free 12-month Quick Plus offer.
items_flat.summary_zh: Amazon表示Seller Assistant現有持久記憶，可全天候跑補貨、定價與警示工作流，仍走Bedrock上的Claude。Selling Partner外掛在Amazon Quick上線，並在Anthropic Claude做測試，另送12個月Quick Plus。
items_flat.analysis_en: The story is Amazon’s distribution of Claude into merchant operations, not a new Anthropic model. The gap to watch is whether approved write-actions stay inside Amazon’s data boundaries.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 重點是Amazon把Claude鋪進賣家營運，不是Anthropic新模型。需觀察獲准的寫入動作是否仍落在Amazon資料邊界內。
items_flat.quote: We are launching the Amazon Selling Partner plugin in Quick and in beta with Claude, with more integrations to follow.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們在Quick推出Amazon Selling Partner外掛，並在Claude進行測試，後續還會有更多整合。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT Voice adds plugins and GPT-6 models
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said ChatGPT Voice can now use plugins such as email, calendar and Slack; be powered by GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna; and run inside ChatGPT Work on web and mobile for spoken document, deck and spreadsheet work.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI表示ChatGPT Voice現可使用電子郵件、行事曆與Slack等外掛；可由GPT-6 Astra、Sol與Luna驅動；並在網頁與手機版ChatGPT Work以語音處理文件、簡報與試算表。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product wiring change, not a new voice model. The practical limit is whether Live-mode plugin actions stay reliable under full-duplex talk, which OpenAI has not published as a benchmark.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產品接線，不是新語音模型。實務限制是全雙工對話下Live模式外掛動作是否穩，OpenAI尚未公布基準。
items_flat.quote: We heard you loud and clear. ChatGPT Voice can now: - Use plugins like your email, calendar, and Slack. - Be powered by GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們聽清楚了。ChatGPT Voice現在可以：使用電子郵件、行事曆與Slack等外掛；由GPT-6 Astra、Sol與Luna驅動。

items_flat.title_en: Musk says Grok Bot usage is accelerating; weekly feature drop
items_flat.title_zh: Musk稱Grok Bot用量加速；週更功能
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk wrote that “Grok @Bot usage is growing faster than anything we’ve ever seen,” quoting Bloomberg coverage that SpaceXAI staff presented 418,000 weekly users in the week ending September 14, up 24% week on week. He separately amplified product-team posts on weekly Grok Bot features.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk寫道「Grok @Bot用量成長比我們見過的任何東西都快」，並引用Bloomberg報導：SpaceXAI內部簡報稱截至9月14日當週有41.8萬週活躍用戶、週增24%。他另轉發產品團隊的Grok Bot週更功能。
items_flat.analysis_en: These are executive and product-team posts, not an xAI model card. The 418k figure is from a staff presentation reported by Bloomberg, not an audited xAI metrics release.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是高管與產品團隊貼文，不是xAI模型卡。41.8萬來自Bloomberg轉述的內部簡報，不是經審計的官方指標。
items_flat.quote: Grok @Bot usage is growing faster than anything we’ve ever seen.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok @Bot的用量成長比我們見過的任何東西都快。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic says health groups use Claude on a DRC Ebola outbreak
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic稱衛生組織用Claude因應剛果（金）伊波拉疫情
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published a feature saying CEPI, WHO AFRO and INRB in Kinshasa are using Claude to speed work on an unusual Ebola variant in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The company framed it as applied outbreak support, not a new model.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic專文稱CEPI、WHO非洲區署與金夏沙INRB正用Claude加速處理剛果民主共和國東部一種異常伊波拉變體。公司定位為防疫應用故事，不是新模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a customer-story post. Independent clinical outcomes, data-handling terms and how much the model changed response time are not in the announcement.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是客戶故事。獨立臨床結果、資料處理條款、模型實際縮短多少應變時間，文中都沒有。
items_flat.quote: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, global health organizations including @CEPIvaccines, @WHOAFRO, and @inrb_kinshasa are using Claude to accelerate their response to an outbreak of an unusual Ebola variant.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在剛果民主共和國，包括CEPI、WHO非洲區署與金夏沙INRB等全球衛生組織正使用Claude，加速因應一種異常伊波拉變體疫情。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI for 30,000 partners
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI與Grab推出GO Forward with AI，覆蓋3萬名夥伴
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI and Grab launched a two-year regional program to teach practical AI skills to 30,000 Grab driver, delivery and merchant partners. It started in Singapore on September 23 and is slated for Thailand, Indonesia and the Philippines later this year, then Malaysia and Vietnam in 2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI與Grab啟動兩年區域計畫，教3萬名司機、外送與商家夥伴實用AI技能。9月23日先在新加坡開課，今年稍後到泰國、印尼與菲律賓，2027年到馬來西亞與越南。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is distribution and skilling, not a model release. Impact depends on completion rates and whether workshop use converts into lasting paid or work-tool usage.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是通路與培力，不是模型發布。成效取決於完課率，以及工作坊使用會否轉成持續付費或工作工具。
items_flat.quote: Over the next two years, the programme will help 30,000 of Grab’s driver-, delivery-, and merchant-partners across Southeast Asia build skills they can use in their work and businesses.
items_flat.quote_zh: 未來兩年，本計畫將協助東南亞3萬名Grab司機、外送與商家夥伴，培養可直接用在工作與生意上的技能。

anthropic.title_zh: Amazon將賣家工具接到Claude與Quick代理
anthropic.summary_en: Amazon said Seller Assistant now keeps persistent memory and can run always-on workflows for restocking, pricing and alerts, still on Bedrock with Claude. A Selling Partner plugin launches in Amazon Quick and in beta with Anthropic’s Claude, with a free 12-month Quick Plus offer.
anthropic.summary_zh: Amazon表示Seller Assistant現有持久記憶，可全天候跑補貨、定價與警示工作流，仍走Bedrock上的Claude。Selling Partner外掛在Amazon Quick上線，並在Anthropic Claude做測試，另送12個月Quick Plus。
anthropic.analysis_en: The story is Amazon’s distribution of Claude into merchant operations, not a new Anthropic model. The gap to watch is whether approved write-actions stay inside Amazon’s data boundaries.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 重點是Amazon把Claude鋪進賣家營運，不是Anthropic新模型。需觀察獲准的寫入動作是否仍落在Amazon資料邊界內。
anthropic.quote: We are launching the Amazon Selling Partner plugin in Quick and in beta with Claude, with more integrations to follow.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們在Quick推出Amazon Selling Partner外掛，並在Claude進行測試，後續還會有更多整合。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic says health groups use Claude on a DRC Ebola outbreak
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic稱衛生組織用Claude因應剛果（金）伊波拉疫情
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic published a feature saying CEPI, WHO AFRO and INRB in Kinshasa are using Claude to speed work on an unusual Ebola variant in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The company framed it as applied outbreak support, not a new model.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic專文稱CEPI、WHO非洲區署與金夏沙INRB正用Claude加速處理剛果民主共和國東部一種異常伊波拉變體。公司定位為防疫應用故事，不是新模型。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is a customer-story post. Independent clinical outcomes, data-handling terms and how much the model changed response time are not in the announcement.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是客戶故事。獨立臨床結果、資料處理條款、模型實際縮短多少應變時間，文中都沒有。
anthropic.quote: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, global health organizations including @CEPIvaccines, @WHOAFRO, and @inrb_kinshasa are using Claude to accelerate their response to an outbreak of an unusual Ebola variant.
anthropic.quote_zh: 在剛果民主共和國，包括CEPI、WHO非洲區署與金夏沙INRB等全球衛生組織正使用Claude，加速因應一種異常伊波拉變體疫情。

google.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS
google.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS for custom voice design and line-by-line direction, and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS for high-volume, lower-cost speech. Both support 100+ languages and ship in AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Notebook and Vids. Google says Flash TTS leads Hume’s Voice Design Benchmark at 71.4.
google.summary_zh: Google推出Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS（自訂音色與逐句導演）以及面向大量、較低成本的Flash-Lite TTS。兩者支援100多種語言，可在AI Studio、Gemini API、Enterprise、Notebook與Vids使用。Google稱Flash TTS在Hume Voice Design基準拿下71.4、整體第一。
google.analysis_en: This extends Gemini Audio after Live models, competing on controllable production speech rather than a new text flagship. Voice replication is geo-restricted, so availability and rights terms still need checking per market.
google.analysis_zh: 這是接在Live之後擴充Gemini Audio，比的是可導演的製作語音，不是新文字旗艦。聲音複製有地區限制，各地可用性與權利條款仍須核對。
google.quote: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS are our most expressive audio generation models yet.
google.quote_zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS與Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS是我們迄今最具表現力的語音生成模型。

meta.title_en: Meta Connect: Muse comes to glasses with Realtime Avatar
meta.title_zh: Meta Connect：Muse上眼鏡並推出Realtime Avatar
meta.summary_en: At Connect 2026 Meta said Muse will come to its AI glasses in the coming months, and unveiled Muse Realtime Avatar to turn Muse Realtime Voice into a live talking face. It also launched camera-free Ray-Ban Meta Audio glasses, more Ray-Ban/Oakley/Meta styles, and Meta VR Glasses (about 100 g, on sale spring 2027 at $1,299.99).
meta.summary_zh: Connect 2026上，Meta宣布未來數月把Muse接到AI眼鏡，並發表Muse Realtime Avatar，把Realtime Voice變成可即時對話的臉。同時推出無相機的Ray-Ban Meta Audio、更多眼鏡款式，以及約100克的Meta VR Glasses（預計2027年春上市，售價1,299.99美元）。
meta.analysis_en: The AI story is distribution of Muse onto always-on wearables, not a new flagship text model. Whether Realtime Avatar stays consistent in long calls, and when glasses Muse ships outside the US, is still a product question.
meta.analysis_zh: 重點是把Muse鋪到全天候穿戴裝置，不是新的旗艦文字模型。Realtime Avatar長通話是否穩、眼鏡版Muse何時出美國，仍是產品問題。
meta.quote: @finkd just unveiled Muse Realtime Avatar, our real-time embodiment technology that turns Muse Realtime Voice into expressive, interactive avatars.
meta.quote_zh: Zuckerberg剛發表Muse Realtime Avatar，這項即時具身技術把Muse Realtime Voice變成有表情、可互動的虛擬形象。

links.label: Meta Newsroom — Ray-Ban Meta Audio / Muse on glasses

xai.title_en: Musk says Grok Bot usage is accelerating; weekly feature drop
xai.title_zh: Musk稱Grok Bot用量加速；週更功能
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk wrote that “Grok @Bot usage is growing faster than anything we’ve ever seen,” quoting Bloomberg coverage that SpaceXAI staff presented 418,000 weekly users in the week ending September 14, up 24% week on week. He separately amplified product-team posts on weekly Grok Bot features.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk寫道「Grok @Bot用量成長比我們見過的任何東西都快」，並引用Bloomberg報導：SpaceXAI內部簡報稱截至9月14日當週有41.8萬週活躍用戶、週增24%。他另轉發產品團隊的Grok Bot週更功能。
xai.analysis_en: These are executive and product-team posts, not an xAI model card. The 418k figure is from a staff presentation reported by Bloomberg, not an audited xAI metrics release.
xai.analysis_zh: 這是高管與產品團隊貼文，不是xAI模型卡。41.8萬來自Bloomberg轉述的內部簡報，不是經審計的官方指標。
xai.quote: Grok @Bot usage is growing faster than anything we’ve ever seen.
xai.quote_zh: Grok @Bot的用量成長比我們見過的任何東西都快。

frontier_other.title_en: Altman and Amodei brief UN Security Council on AI risk
frontier_other.title_zh: Altman與Amodei向聯合國安理會簡報AI風險
frontier_other.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei addressed a UN Security Council session on AI during UNGA week. Altman, in person, called for international standards on measuring capabilities, assessing risks, checking safeguards and keeping human oversight. Amodei, by video, called AI the most important global security issue if mismanaged and urged narrow agreements, including a ban on using AI for biological weapons, plus verification and incident notification.
frontier_other.summary_zh: OpenAI執行長Sam Altman與Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei在聯大周期間向聯合國安理會說明AI。Altman現場呼籲就能力測量、風險評估、防護是否足夠與人類監督建立國際標準。Amodei視訊表示若管理失當，AI可能危及全人類，並主張先談窄範圍協議（含禁止用AI製造生物武器）、查核與重大資安事件通報。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is the highest-profile political forum the two labs have shared this week, but it is testimony, not a treaty. Whether the Council or member states turn the asks into measurable standards remains unproven.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這是本週兩家實驗室同台層級最高的政治場合，但仍是作證而非條約。安理會或會員國會否把訴求變成可量測標準，目前無法證實。
frontier_other.quote: I believe that this is the most important global security issue facing the world today. If managed poorly, I even believe that A.I. could be a risk to humanity as a whole.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我認為這是當今世界最重要的全球安全議題。若管理失當，我甚至相信AI可能對全人類構成風險。

brief_en: Altman and Amodei briefed the UN Security Council on AI risk. Meta Connect put Muse on glasses with Realtime Avatar. OpenAI extended Daybreak to Ukraine and shipped MentalHealthBench plus Voice plugins. Google launched Gemini 3.8 TTS. Anthropic said Claude found an ART phage enzyme system.
brief_zh: Altman與Amodei向安理會簡報AI風險。Meta Connect把Muse接到眼鏡並發表Realtime Avatar。OpenAI把Daybreak給烏克蘭、發布MentalHealthBench與Voice外掛。Google推出Gemini 3.8 TTS。Anthropic稱Claude發現ART噬菌體酶系統。
